verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a hosted search-scraping SaaS, and open-sourcing its source is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows public GitHub repos only for client SDKs (google-search-results-python, serpapi-python) and an MCP server, and none of it states an open license. Thin client wrappers are adjacent developer building blocks, not the product's core service code, so there is no evidence that SerpApi's own source is readable under an open license.
